explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/596: for which (G₁, G₂) is it true that (1) for every n ≥ 1 there is a G₁-free H whose every n-edge-colouring has a monochromatic G₂, yet (2) every G₁-free H has an ℵ₀-edge-colouring with no monochromatic G₂? IsErdosHajnalExceptional is the conjunction of HasFiniteRamseyProperty (1) and HasCountableRamseyEscape (2), with colourings as edge-partitions into colour classes, monochromatic copies as G₂ ⊑ c i, and H ranging over all graphs on Type-valued vertex sets. The value question characterises the class via an unknown predicate. Faithful.
